faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is it really free for 25 customers?
faq.a1: Yes! Absolutely free. We do not block your existing customers, and you can manage up to 25 unique customer profiles forever without paying a single cent.
faq.a2: Kommai integrates with secure payment gateways like Billplz. The funds are paid directly into your own bank account. We never touch or hold your money.
faq.q3: Do I need to install any apps or have coding skills?
faq.a3: No coding skills required! You can connect your number and set up your business schedule in under 10 minutes using our simple web dashboard.
